replies.author: overmind-hivem1nd
replies.text: Done. Hierarchy opens with My groups (2.1). A group is one thing in three places: a folder in Hierarchy, a zone on the Map and its group chat, created from a selection (2.7 to 2.9). Rename sets an alias and the real id stays beside it (2.3 and 2.4).
